## Faster streaming from the SSD
When a mixture-of-experts model is bigger than the memory you give it, Astronomical reads the experts each word needs from the SSD while it writes. This release reads them with a new native reader, straight into the memory the graphics processor works from, with no second copy and no detour through the macOS file cache.
- Ornith 1.5 35B-A3B 4-bit as an Expert Atlas, 10 GB memory limit, nothing held in the macOS file cache: 22.9 tokens a second, up from 14.7. - The same model at 20 GB: 19.7 ms a token, down from 26.1. - Held whole in memory: as fast as before. - Replies are word for word the same as before.
## New in the catalog
- **Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B-MLX-8bit-vision as an Astro Atlas.** The same weights as the 8-bit vision build, stored so each expert is read from the SSD in one step. With a 10 GB limit it writes 16.7 tokens a second against 12.1 for the regular build.
## Also
- `astronomical models convert-atlas` now converts vision models made with `astronomical vision add`, whose vision tower sits in its own `model-vision.safetensors`. - Astro's skills each have one consistent icon, and the home cards use the graphite palette. - A failing drive is now reported as a drive error, not as a model file that is too short.
## Compatibility
Your settings, conversations and downloaded models carry over unchanged. Expert Atlas models made by earlier releases keep working.
Astronomical 0.2.118 is signed with a Developer ID, notarized by Apple, and delivered through the direct download and the signed Sparkle update feed.
